literal: Without being confused, in the action determined, without wavering, delay having discarded, to perform.
translation: Perform the action that has been clearly decided without any confusion, doing so without faltering and discarding all delay.
modern: மனக்குழப்பம் இல்லாமல் ஆராய்ந்து முடிவு செய்த செயலை, சோர்வடையாமல், காலந்தாழ்த்துதலை நீக்கிச் செய்ய வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the ideal execution of a chosen task. First, the action must be decided upon 'without confusion' (kalankātu kaṇṭa). Once decided, one must perform it 'without faltering' (tuḷaṅkātu) or wavering in resolve. Finally, the poet emphasizes 'discarding delay' (tūkkam kaṭintu), as procrastination can ruin even the best-planned efforts. The key words 'kalankātu' (unconfused) and 'tuḷaṅkātu' (unfaltering) show the progression from mental clarity to physical steadfastness.
